$comment: Curated publication list for Gamma decks. Nothing reaches /community unless it is here.
The Gamma workspace is a working scratchpad, not a publication queue: ~150 gammas, with
'Renaissance AI Fund' alone existing as roughly 14 editions of one document. Each entry below
is the latest edition of its family; supersedesGammaIds records the editions it collapses so
the choice stays auditable. Non-HushhTech work in the workspace (client decks, unrelated
topics, untitled drafts) is deliberately absent.
accessLevel drives two things that must agree: publishedWithAccess() in
api/community/content-service.js filters the API response, and assetPrefix decides the GCS
path. isNdaAsset() gates on ^(gated|nda|private|sensitive)/ — plain decks/ is public and
cacheable, so an NDA deck on a public prefix would publish fund material.
supersedesGammaIds holds Gamma ids, not post slugs. PostData.supersedes takes slugs; these
editions were never published as posts, so there are no slugs to reference.
